999008199.text: そんな、みんな石化しちゃったなんて……

石化しない相棒たちが時間を稼いでるけど、
どこまで持つかは正直分かんないよ

localizations.en: The ones who couldn't be petrified are buying time, but honestly? I have no idea how long they can hold out.

999008199.text:
今こうしている間にも戦ってるなんて。
異邦人に援軍を求めに行く時間は……厳しいわね

localizations.en: They're fighting for their lives right now as we speak. Going to find reinforcements from the wanderers... that's not going to be fast enough.

999008199.text: こういうときのための光星隊なのに……っ

localizations.en: This is exactly what the Star Vanguard is supposed to be for...!

999008199.text:
とにかく、今は一分一秒も大事！
すぐに石化を治すための薬を調合するよ！

localizations.en: Then every second counts! I'll start synthesizing a cure for the petrification right now!

999008199.text:
レシピは……レスナのアトリエに参考になりそうなのが
あったはず。向こうになら、素材ももっとある

localizations.en: There should be something useful for the recipe back at Resna's atelier. And she'll have more materials there too.

999008199.text: うん、できる。アタシに任せて！

localizations.en: I can do this. Leave it to me!

999008199.text: っしゃい、できた！
早いな！？

量もちょっとだけの、試薬ですから！
この方向性でいいのか、確認したい……！

localizations.en: It's just a small test batch! I need to make sure I'm heading in the right direction...!

999008199.text: 失敗したときのことを考えて、服のとこらへんで……

localizations.en: Just to be safe, I'll test it on the petrified part of the clothing first...

999008199.text: こいつは……！

うん、上手くいった！　石化なんて初めてだったけど
この考え方で間違ってない！

localizations.en: It worked! I've never dealt with petrification before, but this is the right approach!

999008199.text:
これまで錬金術と真摯に向き合っていたから、
緊急事態でも正解を導けたのね

localizations.en: All those hours you've spent devoted to your craft... that's what let you find the answer under pressure.

999008199.text:
本当に、調合の引き出しを増やしといてよかった……
あとは素材の確保と時間との勝負！

localizations.en: I'm really glad I kept building up my synthesis repertoire... Now it's all about gathering materials as fast as possible!

999008199.text:
素材の確保は任せて。どんな魔物相手でも
生き血が必要なら絞って持ってくる

localizations.en: Leave the materials to me. Whatever monsters we need to bleed dry, I'll get it done.

999008199.text:
物騒ね！　でもそういうのは冒険者の十八番よ。
ぜひ私にも手伝わせてちょうだい！

localizations.en: Blunt as ever! But that's exactly what adventurers are for. Let me help with that!

999008199.text:
そういえばあなたは……？
話をうかがう限り、冒険者のようだが……

localizations.en: Speaking of which—who are you exactly? From what I've gathered, you're an adventurer...?

999008199.text:
ええ、私は冒険者、メーヴェ・シュテルネンリヒト。
レスナの母親でもあるわ！

localizations.en: That's right. Meave Sternenlicht, adventurer—and Resna's mother!

999008199.text:
うちの娘を石像にしてくれた
九偉人のヘルトとかいうの、絶ッッ対許せん！

localizations.en: Whoever this Held of the Miraculous Nine is, turning my daughter into a statue is something I will absolutely not forgive!

999008199.text:
ええ、あいつには私も煮え湯を飲まされた……
この手でなんとしても一矢報いてやる！

localizations.en: You and me both. He's made my blood boil... and I intend to make him pay for it personally.

999008199.text:
アタシもあいつに目にもの見せてやりたいのは同じ！
みんなで力を合わせてやったりましょ！

localizations.en: Same here—I want to give him a piece of my mind too! Let's put everything we've got together and take him down!

999008199.text:
ええ！　そこでアルビーナにちょっと相談があるの。
ヘルトへの対抗策を考えたんだけど……

localizations.en: Exactly! Actually, Alvina, I wanted to run something by you. I've been thinking about how we can counter Held...

999008199.text: んん？　なんでございましょ――

えっ？　いや、無茶な……ただでさえ今は
石化解除薬で手いっぱいなんすけど

localizations.en: Wait—that's... that's a tall order. I'm already stretched thin just working on the petrification cure!

999008199.text:
その薬の素材集めは手伝ってあげるし、
そっち優先でいいから、後で考えておいて！

localizations.en: We'll help you gather materials for that, so take care of it first—just think it over when you get the chance!

999008199.text:
ええー……分かった、分かりました！
なんとかしてみますから素材よろしくお願いします！

localizations.en: Ugh... alright, fine! I'll figure something out—but you'd better come through on those materials!
